sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(s.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  LEFT(s.seller_id, 10) AS seller_name,
  ABS(COALESCE(SUM(opt.order_payment_total), 0)) AS total_revenue
FROM sellers s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, oi.order_id
  FROM order_items oi
) so ON s.seller_id = so.seller_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT op.order_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_payment_total
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
) opt ON so.order_id = opt.order_id
GROUP BY LEFT(s.seller_id, 10)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
